name: Compensated Anarchist
hook: Builds bombs and traps from junk; weak in a straight fight.

name: Prizefighter
hook: Combo strikes; bonus when unarmed and unarmored.

name: Agent Provocateur
hook: Bait enemies into fighting each other and frame rivals; trouble follows every room you enter.

name: Origamist
hook: Folds paper from scrolls, flyers, and junk into one-use constructs; running out of paper is the limit.

name: Shieldmaiden
short: Block hits and shrug off damage.
hook: Blocks reduce damage and protect pets.

name: Football Hooligan
hook: Chaos: extra damage when outnumbered, plus property damage.

name: Roller Derby Jammer
hook: High evasion; shoulder-checks knock enemies off balance.

name: Monster Truck Driver
short: Summon a truck. Run things over.
hook: Summon a truck once per floor for a huge, loud charge.

name: Shotgun Messenger
hook: Burst damage from limited shells; reloading costs a turn.

name: Beastmaster
short: A tamed animal fights beside you.
hook: A tamed animal companion that levels with you.

name: Cartographer
short: Reveals the map and finds secrets.
hook: Reveals more of the fog-of-war map and spots secret rooms.

name: Fire Mage Arcanist
short: Strong fire magic. Mind your loot.
hook: Strong fire spells; fire can burn your own loot.

name: Blizzardmancer
hook: Freeze and slow enemies; control over raw damage.

name: NecroBard
hook: Songs raise minions; performance checks.

name: Animal Test Subject
hook: Poison spells and poison immunity; you glow green, so stealth suffers.

name: Boring Ol' Mage
hook: Pure caster with cheap spells and no weapon skills.

name: Freelance Psychiatrist
short: Calm, confuse, or talk down foes.
hook: Calm, confuse, or talk down enemies with mind skills.

name: Gut Rearranger
short: Field surgery and messy sneak attacks.
hook: Field surgery heals you; sneak attacks get messy.

name: Former Child Actor
short: Borrow a new class trick each floor.
hook: Borrow a different class gimmick on each new floor.

name: Banana Farmer
short: Shoot seeds that grow into cover.
hook: Shoot banana seeds that grow into cover, food, or distractions.
